ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a food web diagram. In the lower-left area there is a “Krill” label, below Krill is “Microplankton,” and there is an arrow from Krill pointing to Microplankton. In the image, arrow relationships such as Killer Whales pointing to Seals, Birds, and other prey can also be seen, indicating that an arrow means a certain organism eats the organism pointed to by the arrow. Reasoning: The question asks which organism is a herbivore (an herbivorous animal/an animal that feeds on plant producers or plankton). According to the arrow in the image, Krill eats Microplankton, so Krill fits the judgment of herbivore.
